description: Demo build: every page noindex, robots.txt disallows all, no sitemap, X-Robots-Tag header, a closable demo banner and sample-image badges. Retired by go-live.

boundaries: This is a demo build (`demo: true` in `src/data/site.ts`). It must stay out of search: never remove the noindex, robots or banner logic by hand. `node <web-scaffold>/create.mjs go-live` takes it live.
Sample content (stock photos, stand-in text) is fine in a demo, but mark it: `Picture` adds a "Sample image" badge, and `Placeholder` stands in for missing media. Track each one in the open items.

manual: Before showing the client, replace stand-in text you can confirm and list the rest in the open items.
